description: This file defines a custom exception class 'JsonFieldSelectorInvalidException' used for handling invalid field selector formats within a JSON processing context. It includes a nested builder class for constructing instances fluently, and extends a runtime exception specific to JSON errors.

classes.name: JsonFieldSelectorInvalidException
classes.description: A runtime exception indicating an invalid JSON field selector format. Contains a static error code, an inner static builder class, and inherits from JsonRuntimeException.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: A mutable builder class used to fluently create instances of JsonFieldSelectorInvalidException. Provides methods to set the invalid field selector message and constructs the exception object.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Returns a new builder instance for constructing JsonFieldSelectorInvalidException objects.

methods.name: fieldSelector
methods.description: Sets a descriptive message indicating which field selector string was invalid, used within the builder pattern.

methods.name: doBuild
methods.description: Constructs a new JsonFieldSelectorInvalidException instance with provided parameters.
